items.exampleEn: The town has only one physician, so she is always busy.
items.exampleZh: 鎮上只有一位醫師，所以她總是很忙。

items.exampleEn: Our pharmacist speaks English, Japanese and Chinese.
items.exampleZh: 我們的藥師會說英文、日文和中文。

items.exampleEn: He goes to speech therapy every Tuesday after school.
items.exampleZh: 他每週二放學後去上語言治療課。

items.exampleEn: A good therapist listens carefully and never laughs at your problems.
items.exampleZh: 好的治療師會仔細傾聽，從不嘲笑你的問題。

items.exampleEn: The first vaccine was made more than two hundred years ago.
items.exampleZh: 第一種疫苗在兩百多年前就做出來了。

items.exampleEn: Most patients who are hospitalized here stay for less than three days.
items.exampleZh: 在這裡住院的病人大多住不到三天。

items.sentenceEn: The pharmacist at the corner pharmacy knows everyone in the neighborhood.
items.sentenceZh: 街角那家藥局的藥師認識附近的每一個人。

items.audioEn: Our manager was hospitalized for two days, so the meeting has been moved to next Monday.
items.audioZh: 我們經理住院兩天，所以會議改到下星期一。
options: The manager was on a trip abroad
The manager was in the hospital

items.sentenceEn: The hospital offers art therapy classes on Wednesday afternoons.
items.sentenceZh: 這家醫院每週三下午有藝術治療課程。

items.sentenceEn: My cousin works as a physical therapist at a sports center.
items.sentenceZh: 我的表親在一間運動中心當物理治療師。

items.stemEn: The ____ must be kept cold, so the truck that carries it has a fridge.
items.stemZh: 疫苗必須冷藏，所以運送疫苗的卡車有冰箱。

items.stemEn: Last winter, about two hundred people in our town were ____ because of the flu.
items.stemZh: 去年冬天，我們鎮上約有兩百人因流感住院。

items.passageEn: When Amy was twelve, her grandmother was hospitalized after a fall. Amy visited her every day and watched the hospital staff at work. The physician checked her grandmother each morning, and a pharmacist explained her medicine to the family. But Amy was most interested in the therapist who helped her grandmother walk again. The therapy took three months, and it was slow and tiring, but the therapist always made the exercises entertaining. Today, Amy is studying to become a therapist herself. Last week, her class visited a lab where scientists are developing a new vaccine, and Amy said it was the most interesting day of the year.
items.passageZh: Amy 十二歲時，奶奶跌倒後住進了醫院。Amy 每天去看她，觀察醫院的工作人員工作。醫師每天早上幫奶奶檢查，藥師向家人說明她的用藥。但 Amy 最感興趣的，是幫助奶奶重新走路的治療師。治療花了三個月，過程緩慢又累人，但治療師總能讓那些運動變得很有趣。如今，Amy 正在讀書，準備自己也成為一名治療師。上週，她的班級參觀了一間科學家正在研發新疫苗的實驗室，Amy 說那是她今年最有趣的一天。

questions.questionZh: 治療師怎麼讓治療比較輕鬆？
options: 每天只做五分鐘的運動
讓奶奶在家自己做運動
請家人一起陪奶奶運動

questions.questionZh: 上週 Amy 的班級去了哪裡？
options: 奶奶以前住的那家醫院

items.promptZh: 她的父親是一位在鄉下行醫三十年的醫師。
referenceEn: Her father is a physician who has worked in the countryside for thirty years.
Her father has been a physician in the countryside for thirty years.
rubricZh: 持續到現在的事，時態配合內容（例如 has worked、has been 等）

items.promptZh: 我姊姊大學畢業後成為一名藥師。
referenceEn: My older sister became a pharmacist after she graduated from university.
After finishing university, my sister became a pharmacist.
rubricZh: 「大學畢業後」可寫，例如 after she graduated、after finishing university 等，位置不限
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 became、has become 等）；寫 has become 也正確
